129430.job_description:
A Data & Information Architect is a professional responsible for designing, structuring, and organizing data systems within an organization. Their role ensures that data is efficiently collected, stored, processed, and accessed across various systems. They work closely with other teams (e.g., IT, software engineers, business analysts) to create data solutions that meet business requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement data architecture frameworks
  • Ensure data quality and governance standards
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval processes
